newsitem.title: USA: Fed seen adding reserves via weekend system RPs.
newsitem.headline: Fed seen adding reserves via weekend system RPs.

text.p: The Federal Reserve is expected to add temporary reserves to the banking system on Friday through weekend system repurchase agreements, Wall Street economists said.
"I expect weekend system RPs today," said Kevin Flanagan, economist and first vice-president at Dean Witter Reynolds.
Analysts at consulting firm MMS International also see the Fed adding reserves through system repurchase agreements.
Experts did not rule out the possibility of a coupon pass on Friday, though they said the Fed was more likely to carry such a move sometime next week.
At 0925 EST/1425 GMT, federal funds were traded at 5-7/16 percent, above the Fed's 5-1/4 percent target for the rate.
